# Lab 18.3: Authorized Datasets & Authorized Routines

## What We Are Going to Do
Authorize a whole dataset of views at once, and authorize a table function so it can read private data.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Add another view.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE VIEW lab18_shared.age_bands AS
SELECT CASE WHEN age &lt; 25 THEN '&lt;25' WHEN age &lt; 45 THEN '25-44' ELSE '45+' END AS band, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM lab18_private.users GROUP BY band;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   It fails for the analyst, because only `users_by_country` was authorized.

2. **[CLI] Authorize the whole shared dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq show --format=prettyjson lab18_private &gt; private_acl.json
python3 - &lt;&lt;'EOF'
import json, os
d = json.load(open("private_acl.json"))
d["access"].append({"dataset": {"dataset": {"projectId": os.environ["PROJECT_ID"], "datasetId": "lab18_shared"},
                                "targetTypes": ["VIEWS"]}})
json.dump(d, open("private_acl.json", "w"))
EOF
bq update --source private_acl.json lab18_private</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Every view in `lab18_shared`, now and in the future, can read `lab18_private`.

3. **[SQL] Create a table function.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION lab18_shared.users_in(c STRING) AS
SELECT first_name, age FROM lab18_private.users WHERE country = c;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Authorize the routine.** Open `lab18_private → Sharing → Authorize routines` and add `lab18_shared.users_in`.

5. **[CLI] Test as the analyst.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud config set auth/impersonate_service_account $ANALYST
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT * FROM lab18_shared.age_bands'
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT * FROM lab18_shared.users_in("India") LIMIT 5'
gcloud config unset auth/impersonate_service_account</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Authorized dataset | All its views authorized at once |
| Authorized routine | UDF or TVF reads private data |
| ACL entries | `dataset` and `routine` types |
| Benefit | Less admin as views are added |
